rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Encode the accepted proof dependency graph with exact statement versions, hypotheses, units, source pins, and unresolved leaves. Reject any cycle passing through the final FEI claim.

deliverables.description: PROOF_DEPENDENCIES.json: versioned mathematical statements and unresolved leaves

acceptance_criteria: Treat mathematical implication edges separately from advisory packet reuse and reviewer routing.
Every accepted lemma has a complete source, immutable revision, hypotheses, and evidence state; an OPEN target cannot be silently treated as proved.
Reject a proof cycle containing the desired FEI theorem, and preserve any genuinely conditional theorem with its unproved premise visible.

next_consumers.interface_use: exact statement graph and original sources

assignments.renewal_milestone: One usable dependency schema and baseline graph are accepted; update only when a source statement/version changes.

assignments.target_statement: Produce rational or symbolic certificates for finite extremal estimates needed by an analytic argument. State separately the theorem that makes this finite domain exhaustive for the intended application.

deliverables.description: FINITE_INEQUALITY_CERTIFICATE.json: exact finite domain and algebraic witnesses
EXHAUSTIVENESS_LEMMA.tex: separate theorem connecting the finite domain to the application

acceptance_criteria: State the finite parameter/case domain exactly and certify every extremal reduction used to shrink it.
Provide rational/symbolic certificates with a checker or a complete hand-verifiable argument.
If the finite domain exhausts an all-dimensional application, prove that reduction separately; without it the result remains a finite statement.
assignments.renewal_milestone: Only a finite estimate required by a named analytic argument receives continuation; unused certificate infrastructure is not a goal.

assignments.target_statement: Formalize one small, decisive identity or combinatorial lemma using an available proof assistant only if it reduces a concrete risk. Do not spend the campaign building unrelated formalization infrastructure.

deliverables.description: FORMAL_CORE: minimal proof-assistant source for one decisive lemma
FORMAL_SCOPE.md: exact theorem, trusted dependencies, and executable verification receipt

acceptance_criteria: Choose an available proof assistant and an existing small lemma whose formalization resolves a concrete identified risk.
Check the exact theorem with no admitted proof holes or extra axioms asserting the target; record the trusted foundational/library assumptions.
State which surrounding analytic lemmas remain outside the certificate; no global formal-verification claim follows from one formal identity.
assignments.renewal_milestone: Continue only after a small accepted formal target and an available environment are confirmed; otherwise reuse analytic review without building unrelated infrastructure.

assignments.target_statement: Certify a compact bias or weight region by interval bounds together with analytic boundary reductions. A grid alone does not cover all real parameter values.

deliverables.description: CONTINUUM_REGION_CERTIFICATE.json: compact boxes, outward bounds, and coverage
BOUNDARY_REDUCTION.tex: proof covering omitted zero/one or unbounded limits

acceptance_criteria: Cover the entire declared compact region with certified bounds; point samples do not certify intervals between them.
Prove the analytic reductions at deterministic biases, vanishing deficits, unbounded weights, or large arity when those lie outside the compact region.
State the exact dimension/arity range and do not infer all-arity validity from one finite-dimensional box.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A complete continuum certificate for a region genuinely needed by a live theorem, with every excluded boundary paid analytically.

assignments.target_statement: Try to invalidate every numerical-to-universal bridge through a missed endpoint, underflow, insufficient precision, or hidden dimension cutoff. Supply the smallest explicit failure or a completed scope check.

deliverables.description: CERTIFICATE_ADVERSARY.md: endpoint, precision, coverage, and exhaustiveness review
CERTIFICATE_FAILURE.json: smallest explicit failure or completed scope verdict

acceptance_criteria: Reconstruct the exact target and domain from original inputs, including zero atoms, deterministic biases, and the largest claimed dimension.
Try underflow, incorrect rounding direction, empty intervals, unsupported library-error assumptions, and unproved symmetry reductions.
Distinguish a valid finite certificate from the separate all-real or all-dimensional bridge; report the first unsupported implication.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One decisive certificate receives an independent scope verdict with a concrete defect or a complete accepted domain.
